headline: Mauricio Pochettino: Man United players must relearn 'about being winners'
description: Mauricio Pochettino has said his first job as Manchester United's new head coach is to remind the players how to win after a miserable start to the season.

headline: Predicting how all 20 Premier League teams will finish the season
description: After 10 games, we have enough data to predict every Premier League team's final spot in the standings for the 2026-27 season.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Premier League clubs eye Cristiano Ronaldo successor Forbs
description: Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs is being tracked by a host of Premier League clubs after taking over the Portugal No. 7 shirt from Cristiano Ronaldo. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Manchester United finally get Mauricio Pochettino after a decade of near misses
description: After years of near misses and missed opportunities, Mauricio Pochettino is finally taking charge at Manchester United following a decade-long pursuit.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United's Matthijs de Ligt on Besiktas' radar
description: Could Matthijs de Ligt end up leaving Manchester United for a move to Turkey? Transfer Talk has the latest.
